summary: FoundationStereo GitHub README: 6x TRT-FP16 speedup on RTX 3090, ONNX/TRT docker path, Jetson Orin support. IGEV-Stereo README confirms 0.18s/0.38s runtimes are on RTX 3090.

IGEV-Stereo own Table 1 via extract_paper_metrics.py: full model 12.60M params + 0.37s @32iters. Disambiguated runtime: chart uses 16-iter 0.18s (Table 5). Noted C028 depends_on C025 (RTX 3090 hardware). RAFT baseline in IGEV ablation uses MobileNetV2 backbone, explaining 12.02M vs vanilla 11.12M discrepancy.

DEFOM-Stereo Tables 3-4 via extract_paper_metrics.py: full finetuned KITTI/Middlebury/ETH3D headline numbers + cross-method run-time survey (16 methods). chart_data.csv: NMRF latency 90ms, StereoBase 290ms (from cross-method table, HW heterogeneous).

Stereo Anything PDF lacks param table; pivoted to OpenStereo repo. Found Model Zoo with cross-method SF EPE for 17+ models (LightStereo-S/M/L/H, StereoBase, FoundationStereo etc.). Deployment doc confirms TRT pipeline ships but ZERO benchmark numbers published — corroborates SQ6 finding from independent source.

CGI-Stereo Tab 6 speed/accuracy tracks (HITNet 20ms / DeepPrunerFast 62ms / etc.) + StereoVoxelNet 35Hz RTX 3090 + Jetson TX2 + 5.40M params + 17.31G MACs. P016 added to chart_data with edge HW. NOTE: chart_data hasnt added P011 because its Tab 6 numbers are finetuned KITTI not zero-shot Mean — different axis.

Self-stated limitation: textureless walls + transparent glass — parallels P021 framing. SQ7 (per-distance proxied by TEPE temporal consistency) closed.

RobustSpring Table 2b extracted: 6 stereo methods (RAFT-Stereo / ACVNet / LEAStereo / GANet x SF/KITTI ckpts) on 20 corruption classes. RAFT-Stereo most robust (avg R1px 33.40). NO foundation-VFM models evaluated — round 4 follow-up. Closes SQ8 critical-review + SQ9 dataset cells with concrete numbers.
